snippet.title: Thanks for the Soup | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The job's simple: Go around town and satisfy your customers with some nice and hot soup. Hop on your bicycle and go around town, make some money, buy items, take care of your cat, and much more in this immersive horror simulator.

Thanks for the Soup is available now in Early Access.
Check it out: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2132610/Thanks_for_the_Soup/

Developed by Solshade Games

#gamedev #indiegame #immersivesim
